title: No spacing-aware item removal: deleting an item with blank-line collapse is byte arithmetic
wanted_capability: A spacing-aware removal primitive — e.g. edits.deleteItem({es, span, collapse: "before"|"after"|"both"}) or a code.leadingTrivia(span) fact — that deletes an item and collapses surrounding blank lines per the one-blank-line-between-items idiom. Tree-sitter emits no blank-line nodes, so cells fall back to trivia_span text inspection and manual byte arithmetic; both mutation probes spent cells on whitespace bookkeeping around the deleted item.
fallback_used: Used trivia_span (which merges leading+trailing trivia) plus code.read inspection and hand-computed zero-width spans.
evidence: prompts/RETRO_ISOLATE_REFACTOR.md retro findings: spans (point-before), missing-algebra (delete with spacing)
